One browser click runs over half a century of「困った」

Networking suddenly looks difficult when Ethernet, IP, TCP, TLS, and DNS are lined up as vocabulary. But if we ask what was inconvenient before each mechanism existed, the stack becomes a history of problem decomposition. Starting from a Naoya Tech video and checking primary RFCs, this essay revisits MAC randomization, the TCP-versus-UDP simplification, current TLS 1.3, QUIC, and HTTP/3.
